My name is  Dr. John Owings (Kilted Chiropractor) the executive director of Advanced Family Chiropractic Center. I'm very  passionate about the benefits of chiropractic and have cared for West Michigan families since 1997. We are now on YouTube and showing the world how we help improve people's health. 

Your health and well-being are our top priority! Advanced Family Chiropractic Center offers therapies to help reduce and eliminate pain. Same-day appointments are frequently available.

We focus on working with the muscles and the joints together, to help restore normal pain-free function as soon as possible.

Your personalized care plan addresses your problem areas specifically and combines chiropractic adjusting, nutrition counseling, massage therapy, exercise, and stress management to maximize your results.

We also will work closely with your family physician so that all of your health care needs are addressed.
